fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, BI (links to VS-28.1/VS-103.3), Audit (links to VS-21), Risk (links to VS-21.2), Ethics Committee (links to W3719), Board Audit Committee (links to VS-36)

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-report of "report volume by channel/category/location, substantiation rate, case…" (replaces manual Step 1).
- System auto-analyze of "Ethics & Compliance Officer analyze trends" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System continuous audit of "Ethics & Compliance Officer publish analytics to the Ethics" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-588 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Analytics, Culture & Program Assurance (PA-119.3).)
- operational: KPI dashboard; operational: culture measurement (W3731)
Pain Points / Risks: - **Metric-blindness risk**: No visibility into report patterns and hotspots; mitigated by KPI dashboard
- **Misleading-metric risk**: Low report volume misread as "no problem" rather than "no trust"; mitigated by culture measurement (W3731)
System Touchpoints: - BI/analytics (links to VS-28.1/VS-103.3); case-management (links to W3720); audit/risk (links to VS-21.2); governance (links to VS-36); risk assessment (links to W3730)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/BI maintain the ethics & speak-up KPI dashboard: report volume by channel/category/location, substantiation rate, case cycle-time, retaliation incidents, repeat-offender/repeat-issue patterns, training completion, and culture-trust score

Ethics & Compliance Officer analyze trends: by category (ABC, fraud, harassment, safety, etc.), by location/entity, over time; identify hotspots, emerging risks, and control-effectiveness decay; benchmark against program maturity and external norms

Ethics & Compliance Officer publish analytics to the Ethics Committee (W3719), board audit committee (links to VS-36), and executives; drive prioritized action on hotspots and feed to risk assessment (W3730) and continuous improvement (W3736)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Risk (links to VS-21.2), Audit (links to VS-21), ABC (links to VS-86), LP (links to VS-23), Procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34), Treasury (links to VS-18), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Cross-Entity (links to VS-72)
fields.Trigger: Annual risk cycle (links to VS-21.2); case trend; change

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Risk conduct the ethics-risk assessment: identify inherent ethics/compliance risks across functions (cash-handling theft, procurement/AP bribery, B2G bid corruption, vendor kickbacks, harassment/discrimination, safety shortcuts, data misuse, conflicts), assess likelihood/impact, and produce the heat-map by function/location/entity
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Risk / Function owners

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer assess control coverage for each risk (preventive/detective), identify gaps, and prioritize mitigation; integrate to enterprise risk management (links to VS-21.2) and the risk register
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Risk / Internal Controls

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer refresh the risk map from case trends (W3729), regulatory change (links to VS-22.3), and business change (new channels, entities, vendors); report residual ethics-risk to the risk committee (links to VS-21.2/VS-36) and drive mitigation

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, HR/EX (links to VS-103.2/VS-103.3), Communications (links to VS-14.3), BI (links to VS-28.1), Store Ops (links to VS-07), Ethics Committee (links to W3719)

Ethics & Compliance Officer/HR-EX analyze results by location/entity/function/demographic, identify low-trust hotspots, and correlate with report volume/analytics (W3729) to distinguish "no misconduct" from "no trust to report"

Ethics & Compliance Officer/Communications drive culture improvement: targeted leadership/communication/training in low-trust areas (links to W3718), track trust-score improvement, and report culture posture to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and governance (links to VS-36)

workflows.name: Conflict of Interest & Gifts/Integrity Disclosure Management

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-capture of "Ethics & Compliance Officer manage gifts & entertainment" (replaces manual Step 2).
- System auto-review of "review disclosed COIs/G&E for actual/potential conflicts, manage…" (replaces manual Step 3).
Controls: - CTL-588 (ensure controlled execution — Ethics Analytics, Culture & Program Assurance (PA-119.3).)
- operational: annual + on-change declaration; operational: aggregate tracking
Pain Points / Risks: - **Undeclared-COI risk**: At-risk role holds undisclosed conflict; mitigated by annual + on-change declaration
- **Gift-creep risk**: Sub-threshold gifts accumulate to influence; mitigated by aggregate tracking
System Touchpoints: - HR (links to VS-19/VS-103); procurement (links to VS-03/VS-34); merchandising (links to VS-01); finance (links to VS-17); ABC (links to VS-86.3); legal (links to VS-100.3); audit (links to VS-21)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer operate the conflict-of-interest (COI) disclosure program: annual COI declarations and on-change declarations for at-risk roles (procurement, merchandising, finance, B2G sales, AP, treasury), capturing outside interests, related-party relationships, and financial interests that could conflict with BuildRight

Ethics & Compliance Officer manage gifts & entertainment (G&E) per the G&E policy (links to VS-86.3 anti-bribery): capture G&E given/received above threshold, review for bribery/influence risk, approve/reject/declare, and maintain the G&E register; integrate to ABC (links to VS-86.3)
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / ABC / Function owners

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer review disclosed COIs/G&E for actual/potential conflicts, manage recusal/mitigation, and report COI/G&E posture and exceptions to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and audit (links to VS-21); refresh from case learning (W3728)

fields.Participants: Ethics & Compliance Officer, Vendor Mgmt (links to VS-03), Procurement (links to VS-34), ABC (links to VS-86.1), Legal (links to VS-100.3), Finance (links to VS-17), Merchandising (links to VS-01), Risk (links to VS-21.2)
fields.Trigger: Vendor onboarding (links to VS-03); periodic review; integrity concern

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-escalate of "escalate high-risk third parties" (replaces manual Step 1).

- System auto-report of "report third-party integrity risk to the Ethics Committee" (replaces manual Step 3).

System Touchpoints: - Vendor management (links to VS-03); procurement (links to VS-34); ABC/KYC (links to VS-86.1); legal (links to VS-100.3); vendor scorecard (links to VS-67); risk (links to VS-21.2); ethical sourcing (links to W353)

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Vendor Mgmt conduct third-party integrity due diligence at onboarding (links to VS-03.1/W353 ethical sourcing): ownership/beneficial-ownership, sanctions/PEP screening (links to VS-86.1), adverse-media, anti-corruption controls, and integrity risk-rating; escalate high-risk third parties
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Vendor Mgmt / ABC

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer manage high-risk third parties: enhanced due diligence, integrity contractual clauses (anti-bribery, audit rights, termination), ongoing monitoring, and periodic re-screening; coordinate with ABC KYC (links to VS-86.1)

Ethics & Compliance Officer investigate third-party integrity concerns/allegations (kickbacks, bid-rigging, fake invoicing, modern-slavery) with Vendor Mgmt/Legal, manage remediation/delisting (links to VS-67/W2466), and report third-party integrity risk to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and risk (links to VS-21.2)
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Vendor Mgmt / Legal

Automation Opportunity: - System auto-monitor of "Ethics & Compliance Officer/Audit conduct the annual ethics-program audit" (replaces manual Step 1).

Ethics & Compliance Officer assess program effectiveness against a maturity model (ISO 37001/37301-aligned), test controls from the internal-controls matrix, and identify assurance gaps; manage findings to closure
steps.r: Ethics & Compliance Officer / Audit / Internal Controls

steps.activity: Ethics & Compliance Officer/Audit report program-assurance posture and findings to the Ethics Committee (W3719) and board audit committee (links to VS-36); support external audit and regulatory examination
